cashtrail.name: CashTrail
cashtrail.description: Personal finance platform with a FastAPI backend organized in vertical slices, a Next.js frontend and PostgreSQL. Technical decisions are documented in ADRs.
cashtrail.result: CI/CD and automated deployment to Azure Container Apps, with E2E tests
cashtrail.participation: Solo project: architecture (vertical slices and ADRs), backend, frontend, E2E tests, CI/CD and Azure infrastructure.

coremanager.name: CoreManager
coremanager.description: Inventory management system built as my technical school capstone, in framework-free PHP organized in vertical slices: products and suppliers, stock entries and exits, PDF and Excel reports and role-based access control.
coremanager.result: Bought by a company and in production since 2025
coremanager.participation: Group capstone in which I was responsible for development: database, backend and frontend. Since the sale, maintenance and production support have been handled by the group.

coremanagerJava.name: CoreManager (Java)
coremanagerJava.description: A rewrite of CoreManager in Java 21 and Spring Boot, with a layered architecture, to compare both stacks.
coremanagerJava.participation: Solo project: layered architecture, Spring Boot backend, JPA persistence and Thymeleaf views.
coremanagerJava.imageAlt: Screen of the Java version of CoreManager
